findings_and_relationships.condition: Failed filth, personal/shared inventory, amount, catalog or personality queries become ordinary empty vectors. Missing amounts make soap availability zero; missing filth can make available soap look unneeded; missing personality makes is_temperate false, so an otherwise admitted drinking candidate can be predicted to drink. Template states definite availability/consumption based on these plain values.
findings_and_relationships.qualification: Actual failures, item rows, nighttime rest and user-visible discrepancies unobserved. Valid empty inventory, no filth, correctly measured zero and deliberate temperance remain legitimate. Native per-person and party wash/actual evening consumption are distinct from preview; no transaction outcome is inferred.
findings_and_relationships.future_repair_direction: Carry per-source unavailable vs confirmed absence to the preview and use a truthful uncertainty state; retain native custody, personal/shared amounts, temperance and normal nightly-consumption policy. Reconcile q202 centrally.

findings_and_relationships.condition: Cache key rounds and casts f64 coordinates before lookup and returns a hit before native TerrainPack validates finite and in-bounds endpoints. Therefore inputs that normalize to one key but have different admission can receive the same cached plan if a valid plan for that key was inserted.
findings_and_relationships.qualification: Requires an admitted valid cached route and a colliding inadmissible input; actual pack bounds, caller input and hit are unobserved. Intentional sub-metre normalization of two valid points is a separate policy, not automatically a defect. Weather key/profile and bounded immutable package behavior must remain correct.
findings_and_relationships.future_repair_direction: Validate semantic endpoints and native profile/weather before a hit or otherwise prove cache-key equivalence preserves admission, while retaining intended valid sub-metre equivalence and bounded caching.

findings_and_relationships.first_failure: Eight nearby cell results are reduced via ok().flatten() and only successful water samples are counted. A sampling error or no covered cell is indistinguishable from observed nonwater. That count determines coastal (>=4) and wet-ground (1–3 unless center is wetland) booleans. Web includes those booleans in private terrain attestation; backend validates gateway, digest, location and normalized terrain but uses attested booleans in planning. Core habitat logic gates SeaCoast-only seaweed and RiverWetGround-only watercress on those booleans.

No concrete package failure, neighbor values, action, yield or runtime behavior observed. Source does not assert malicious attestation or bypass of gateway authority. Earlier q518/q519 cover center sample causes, not this neighbor reduction.
findings_and_relationships.future_repair_direction: Specify partial coverage versus failed sample policy, retain observation completeness through environment attestation and backend habitat authority, and decide when source eligibility is unknown versus confirmed absent. Preserve valid center/wetland, package edges and gateway/location checks.

nonfindings_and_open_questions: Neither missing terrain nor a failed forward/return terrain plan is silently presented as a real route in the inspected caller: destination carries uses_straight_line_estimate and template labels it. Reusing an already-mutated destination after later plan failure and actual travel initiation remain separate open contracts.

Planner has two owned permits and a bounded 128-entry FIFO cache; permit remains in blocking closure if outer wait times out. This does not prove native worker cancellation, a bound on queued request count or product latency.

Exact/visited destination knowledge maps to explicit display variants; approximate and unknown stages intentionally have no exact-site presentation. Do not infer disclosure from the enum or current source alone.

Filter/normalization of time, weather and public/party inventory rows and the shared strategic clock ownership need end-to-end evidence; calculations are advisory unless their actual consumer/authority is traced.
